basic_info.main_problem: I tend toward black-and-white thinking; as long as one negative aspect stands out, I ignore any positive aspects in the experience. This way of thinking makes me feel pain, especially in social situations.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because I realize my negative thinking patterns are affecting my enjoyment of life and social interactions.
growth_experiences: High expectations and perfectionist standards for experiences and events began forming in adolescence; over time, whenever a negative aspect appears in social activities, performances or daily interactions, the positive side is ignored and the overall experience is defined as terrible; this pattern has become more prominent in recent months, often feeling disappointed and dissatisfied.

core_beliefs: One flaw will ruin the whole thing

special_situations.event: Sound system failure at an indie music show
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If any flaw appears in an event, the whole equals failure, not worth it
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to emphasize the positive by journaling, but when reviewing still focuses attention on negative details
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This performance is ruined; what a terrible night

special_situations.event: Poor food at the work team-building event
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If there is an unsatisfactory part in the experience, it means the whole event is a failure and a waste
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Only talking about the not-good parts afterward, ignoring other positive experiences

special_situations.event: Small setbacks in Social situations (like imperfect arrangements or last-minute technical issues)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Things should go perfectly in the way I expect, otherwise it is a terrible experience
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Sets overly high and rigid expectations for activities in hopes of avoiding disappointment
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This social event turned out terrible, not worth coming

special_situations.event: The opening performance of the indie concert was terrible
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If one part performs poorly, it means the whole evening is terrible
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Focusing on the poorly performing part, treating other positive parts as insignificant
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: The opening was bad, so the whole evening was ruined

core_conflict.wish: Longing for a near-perfect experience to gain satisfaction and a sense of control
core_conflict.fear: Fearing the disappointment and dissatisfaction brought by imperfection
defense_goal: Avoiding disappointment through strict evaluation standards and black-and-white judgments

object_relations.self_representation: A perfection-demanding experiencer who easily negates the whole due to flaws
object_relations.object_representation: Others or activities are viewed as either perfect or awful objects that may disappoint her

manifestations: In social activities, performances, and daily interactions, when one negative aspect appears, has difficulty experiencing meaning and value, and classifies the whole experience as 'terrible'
Often viewing positive fragments as trivial, thus weakening grasp of the event's meaning
outcomes: Heightened sense of disappointment and dissatisfaction
Increased misunderstandings and conflicts in Interpersonal relationships

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: When reviewing experiences, judges self and others by external perfect standards
Expressing some Anxiety and caution about opening up at the start of counseling

positive_force: Having some self-Reflection and journaling ability (trying to focus on the positive by writing a diary)
Has a few close friends who can provide emotional support
Clear motivation to seek help, positive attitude
negative_force: Excessively high expectations and perfectionistic tendencies
Black-and-white thinking and mental filtering; tends to ignore the positive side
Intensified disappointment and dissatisfaction in Social situations, leading to misunderstandings and conflicts
Overall evaluation of events dominated by a single negative detail

target_behavior.behavior: Evaluates in a black-and-white manner in social and entertainment activities and focuses only on the negative
antecedent: Small flaws appearing in social activities, performances or daily interactions, or not matching expectations
Holding excessively high and idealized expectations of activities
target_behavior.core_reason: Long-term high expectations and perfectionist tendencies make her view local flaws as total failure
target_behavior.function: Avoids subjective disappointment, maintains control and certainty over the experience
target_behavior.consequence: Overall mood and enjoyment decline; misunderstandings and conflicts with others arise; social satisfaction decreases
